label: literal
isolates: the COPY-COST FLOOR: a pure literal (the dot escaped so no engine reads a metacharacter), shortening replacement

label: rare
isolates: SEARCH-dominated: output is the input to within a few bytes; a two-literal alternation prefix scanned over the whole file

label: dense
isolates: OUTPUT-dominated: tens of millions of matches, per-match render/append cost

label: reorder
isolates: CAPTURE REARRANGEMENT: three groups, permuted (dd/Mon/yyyy to yyyy-Mon-dd), exactly one per line

label: mask-ipv4
isolates: CLASS-HEAVY masking: bounded counted classes, a word boundary, a fixed-text replacement

label: mask-email
isolates: a widely used e-mail shape: unbounded classes either side of a literal `@`, fixed-text replacement

label: upper
isolates: CASE CHANGE in the template (\U..\E): only some dialects can say it

label: url-tld-fix
isolates: ONE PASS: a backreference inside a negative lookahead + a conditional template segment (fix a wrong TLD value OR insert the missing field)
